text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My favorite kind of firework, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see. I think I would say
sparklers. Like
fleeting and falling buds,
peonies and pine
needles... They remind
me of the transience of all
things.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know I love those classic shells!
Nothing gets
you pumped better than
the bing bang boom!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thankies, both of you! This gives me a
lot to think
about.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm handling some prep for the
next dorm
fireworks festival, I've gotta
figure out what to
stock up on!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, Pearl, you had mentioned that
you
liked rockets?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, great memory, Grass! You got
that right.
Rockets are just excellent!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A trail of light stretching straight into
the great
beyond! A grace that compels
everyone to look
up...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just wonderful! I wanna turn
heads just
like that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl, I bet they'll be calling you rocket
lady in no
time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A rocket that will never burn out, to be
seen
across the night sky in each and
every world.
